'''Randy Schley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Portland Grand Slam]] on 10 June 2000 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL]], according to Joe Olson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d915">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-20-portland-grand-slam-6-10-00d915/ portland-grand-slam-6-10-00], DeckTech (Joe "arebelspy" Olson, 20 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-20-portland-grand-slam-6-10-00d915/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
